metadata.architectural_response: An occupied wedge rises through the full section from a low civic edge to a taller rear volume. The incline is a boundary of usable mass, not a thin roof applied to an unchanged box.
metadata.unresolved_conflicts: Programme, doors, stairs, accessible roof routes, structural member capacity and parking operation remain to be designed and independently verified.
